title: Luxury 6,000 SF Villa - Pool, Sport Courts, Gym!
description:
Modern 6,000 SF villa is your group’s desert dream! Only 15 mins from Old Town, it’s perfect for EVENTS ~ Corporate Retreats ~ Graduations ~ Commercial Use ~ Bachelor Celebrations ~ Videography and more - Send us the word EVENT for more info!
- great sports yard with pickleball/ basketball & volleyball courts
- corn hole, mini putt & pool/game room
- cozy fire pit & outdoor grill
- spacious chef’s kitchen
- Ample on site parking (4+)
- full gym w/ sauna

review_snippets: The property around the pool area was unkept and trashy.  I have pictures of straw hut torn down and hanging, left over cups from last renter, sport court different balls just strewn about, torn gate propped up in back yard…just looked unkept….nit to mention trash coming out of full barrels.  After I text Salvador’s about this, he said to not threaten him with a bad review and told me to find somewhere else to stay and leave.  I have the pictures and the texts.
We all had such a good time and were so impressed with the house! We left some drinks for y’all!!! Enjoy.
Great experience, great host. Definitely recommend for a group. Thank you!

A fantastic place to stay in Scottsdale! Salvatore was an incredibly responsive host and was very flexible with checkin which helped us a lot. The amenities at the property were amazing, would definitely stay again!
Amazing house and very responsive host. Few toiletry items were low and the team responded immediately and sent out the supplies. House was just like the pictures, amazing. Great overall experience!
